items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 55:1
items.html: The closed MEM of the verse 'of the increase of his government' hints at the aspect of the first three of the Mochin that were corrected in the MEM of Tzelem, in the secret of a ring — the correction of the first three of Bina, to be always in the aspect of concealed Hassadim. As in Answer 11 above. (Page 327, Item 68).
